risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing and expiry date stamps on the handle or shroud.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap-bubble leak test on the valve.

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or thinning of the metal walls.

Video of the valve being operated and tested for leaks with soapy water.
response.reason: The item is a standard BESS GAS cylinder. While critical safety data like the expiry date is missing, it can be priced at its worst-case value (expired/scrap) until proof of serviceability is provided.
